review_scope: Paired inspection of all 23 physical surface renders after the front trim source survey renewal. Readable material edges, fitted fixtures and light response are visible.

The plaster and tile catch the same circular bands. Grout and the curtain edge stay visible.
The lamp, window trim, radiator and floorboards remain clearly distinct around the resident.
The ceiling lamp lights the table area. The legs, shelves, window frame and floor joints stay distinct.
The lit wall separates from the upper cupboard, countertop and sink.
The boiler outline, top gauge and pipe remain clear against the dark masonry.
The shelf frame and chair remain readable in the dark corner. The adjacent door and trim stay distinct.
Tile joints turn cleanly into the corner. The cistern and vent trim retain their edges.
The courses and mortar edges remain visible in the dark brick close-up.
The open lid, panel hardware and warm-toned conduit stay readable against the plaster.
The Judge silhouette and brass rail remain separate in the dark recess. The floor tile joints stay visible.
The curled Lafitte, portrait and shelf lip are still distinguishable in the low light.
The shelf brackets and small props at the rear stay visible. The amber spill on the right remains confined.
The candidate has less light on the brass surround. The individual mail slots, labels and adjacent bench remain visible.
The radiator ribs, valve, blinds and sewing cabinet keep distinct edges.
The cage bars, machine and floor shadows remain legible in the warm overhead light.
The tank legs and ladder remain visible against the roof. The tank top stays distinct from the skyline and clouds.
The terminal keeps its green glow. The casing and wall board remain distinct from the surrounding wood.
Tile seams, cistern brackets and the exposed top stay visible under the overhead light.
The residue retains distinct hues in the lamp pool. The radiator and detailed companion remain visible.
The lit tentacle ridges and irregular silhouette stay distinct against the floor and radiator.
The toaster slots and individual crumbs remain visible beside the kettle and cup.
The switch plate and amber dial remain visible against the dark wall.
